design: 18 independent workflows; descriptive condition comparisons and within-workflow changes
primary_conformance: distinct dataset-rule pairs with complete deliverables and full validated coverage; partial-report counts are descriptive only
repair_policy: Every workflow receives one same-session repair with no agent execution time limit; P21 feedback uses usable partial/full reports or self-review fallback when unavailable
report_usability: Fresh parsable report, pinned versions, no installation problems and reported datasets form a nonempty subset of actual produced datasets; unvalidated produced domains remain explicit; no requirement that all 13 planned datasets exist
completeness: Report dataset-set completeness, missing/extra files and required artifact presence separately; retain all 18 planned workflows
semantic_reproduction: exact values, row order, labels, types, storage widths; XML C14N excluding only root CreationDateTime
denominator: all 18 scheduled workflows; missing/extra/duplicates and failures retained separately
qualifications: TTE medical query and treatment-emergent flags conditional on generated ADAE
TTE duration +1 and DM.RFENDTC censor conventions
MedDRA 8.0 HLT/HLGT masked-source provenance not independently confirmed
